messages.text:
Your cancelled card doesn’t stop the refund. The shop sends refunds only to the order’s original payment; the card issuer handles any credit, and the shop can’t promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment).

I’ve proposed BRL 55.00 for the rug. Confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a reply in chat won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
